  that can install Ubuntu packages (keelbox install). The box is this machine. It
  is on your tailnet. SSH from the internet closes once [38;5;179mkeelbox apply workstation[0m
  reaches it over the tailnet from another computer; [38;5;179mkeelbox doctor workstation[0m
  says whether it has.
